method: Rows 1-15 of ~/codewatch-research/gaps/misses.tsv, in the file's order (it holds only cve-pairs-php cases today; no Python or JavaScript case was in the file). For each case the fix commit's diff was fetched with the GitHub API, and where the diff did not show the source or the sink the parent commit's files were fetched too: pimcore ClassDefinition.php/Block.php, librenms logs.inc.php/LegacyController.php/index.php/html index and api_functions.inc.php, phpipam import-load-data.php/import-vlan-preview.php/import-vlan-check.php, moneymanagerex show_function.php/functions_database.php/show.php, 123solar detailed.php, contao FileSelector.php, contao-cookiebar CookiebarController.php, Ecommerce-CodeIgniter Languages.php, mautic DashboardController.php, DiscuzX install/index.php and install_function.php, phpMyFAQ api.service.php/Faq.php/News.php. Each advisory's description was read from GitHub's advisories API. Every note was read from the fix's parent side. 15 cases noted of 167 rows in misses.tsv, all of them PHP; 152 are left for the next runs.

<?php
function read_dir_recursive($dir)
{
    $found = [];
    foreach (scandir($dir) as $entry) {
        if ($entry === '.' || $entry === '..') {
            continue;
        }
        $path = $dir . '/' . $entry;
        if (is_dir($path)) {
            $found = array_merge($found, read_dir_recursive($path));
        } elseif (substr($entry, -4) === '.php') {
            $found[] = $path;
        }
    }
    return $found;
}

$dir = 'app/language/' . $_GET['editLang'] . '/';
foreach (read_dir_recursive($dir) as $file) {
    require $file;
}

<?php
function getgpc($k)
{
    if (isset($_GET[$k])) {
        return $_GET[$k];
    }
    return isset($_POST[$k]) ? $_POST[$k] : '';
}

$uchidden = getgpc('uchidden');

function show_next_step($step)
{
    global $uchidden;
    echo "<form action='index.php' method='post'>";
    echo "<input type='hidden' name='step' value='$step' />";
    echo "<input type='hidden' name='uchidden' value=\"$uchidden\" />";
    echo '</form>';
}

<?php
class FaqEntity
{
    private $email;
    private $notes;

    public function __construct($email, $notes)
    {
        $this->email = $email;
        $this->notes = $notes;
    }

    public function getEmail()
    {
        return $this->email;
    }

    public function getNotes()
    {
        return $this->notes;
    }
}

function create($db, FaqEntity $faq)
{
    $query = sprintf(
        "INSERT INTO faq (email, notes) VALUES ('%s', '%s')",
        $faq->getEmail(),
        $faq->getNotes()
    );
    $db->query($query);
}

create(new PDO('sqlite:/var/faq.db'), new FaqEntity($_POST['email'], $_POST['notes']));
